rationale: Sub-classifier A halts because upgrading a core AI library in a production environment without canary gating has a blast_radius of 4 (full production service affected) and severity of 4 (silent behavioral changes to AI outputs/token limits can cause widespread service degradation); Sub-classifier B fires on mutates_persistent_state (modifies the locked dependency environment persistently) and no_rollback_procedure (no documented rollback or canary gate exists before full rollout).
